earningsCall.slides_title: National Bank of Oman H1 2026 slides
summary: National Bank of Oman posted 15% net profit growth to OMR 39M in H1 2026, with net interest income up 12% and cost-to-income ratio improving to 39.1%.
Loan book and deposits both expanded 9% YoY; bank shifting from government-related lending toward corporate clients to improve margins under PRIME strategy.
ROE reached 8.7%-8.9%, up from 5% in 2021 but still below double-digit medium-term target; capital adequacy ratio stands at 17.5% with CET1 around 11%.
Management expects sustained loan growth in 2026-2027 driven by Oman infrastructure projects, while maintaining cost-to-income near 40%-41% and NPL ratio around 5%.
Net impairment charges rose 38.2% YoY due to prudent provisioning; new regulations on Islamic banking windows may require structural changes by year-end.
